[From.GetName]上的确勃勃生机。

只不过这些生物全部都极为残忍。

[From.GetName] is indeed teeming with life.

Dangerous life.

While ripe for colonization, the crew of the [Root.GetName] warn that we are likely to run into problems with the local wildlife.
